tours.name: Create a Payslip Batch and Generate Payslips

name_i18n.en_US: Create a Payslip Batch and Generate Payslips

tours.description: Learn how to create a payslip batch for a pay period, choose the salary structure, and generate a draft payslip for every employee in one step.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to create a payslip batch for a pay period, choose the salary structure, and generate a draft payslip for every employee in one step.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Payslips for many employees can be produced at once from a batch in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips for many employees can be produced at once from a batch in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu gives access to individual payslips and to payslip batches.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu gives access to individual payslips and to payslip batches.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period, usually a month, so they can be generated, checked and paid together. This list shows the batches already created.

description_i18n.en_US: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period, usually a month, so they can be generated, checked and paid together. This list shows the batches already created.

steps.title: New batch
steps.content: Click New to create a batch.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a batch.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank batch. The period starts and ends on the first and last day of the current month.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank batch. The period starts and ends on the first and last day of the current month.

steps.title: Batch name
steps.content: Type a name for the batch, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a name for the batch, then press Tab.

steps.description: Name the batch after the pay period, for example Salaries October 2026, so it is easy to find later.

description_i18n.en_US: Name the batch after the pay period, for example Salaries October 2026, so it is easy to find later.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the batch.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the batch.

steps.description: The batch must be saved before payslips can be generated. Saving also unlocks the Generate Payslips button.

description_i18n.en_US: The batch must be saved before payslips can be generated. Saving also unlocks the Generate Payslips button.

steps.title: Generate Payslips
steps.description: This opens a window where you choose which employees receive a payslip in this batch. By default it lists every employee with a running contract.

description_i18n.en_US: This opens a window where you choose which employees receive a payslip in this batch. By default it lists every employee with a running contract.

steps.title: Salary structure
steps.content: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of salary structures.

steps.description: The salary structure decides which rules are used to compute the payslips. It is required: choose the structure that matches the employees you are paying.

description_i18n.en_US: The salary structure decides which rules are used to compute the payslips. It is required: choose the structure that matches the employees you are paying.

steps.title: Choose the structure
steps.content: Click the structure to use. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the structure to use. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: Choose the structure of the employees in this batch. Every selected employee then receives a payslip computed with it.

description_i18n.en_US: Choose the structure of the employees in this batch. Every selected employee then receives a payslip computed with it.

steps.title: Generate
steps.content: Click Generate to create the payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Generate to create the payslips.

steps.description: Odoo creates one draft payslip per employee for the batch period and computes it from the employee's contract. Generation can take a little while for many employees.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo creates one draft payslip per employee for the batch period and computes it from the employee's contract. Generation can take a little while for many employees.

steps.title: Open the payslips
steps.content: Click the Payslips button to see the generated payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Payslips button to see the generated payslips.

steps.description: Every employee in the batch now has a draft payslip. This button opens the list of those payslips so you can review them. The next steps are to check them, confirm them and pay them.

description_i18n.en_US: Every employee in the batch now has a draft payslip. This button opens the list of those payslips so you can review them. The next steps are to check them, confirm them and pay them.
